dof.title: Mobility (Gruebler)
dof.rank: Instantaneous DOF at the reference pose: {{rank}}

explain.ok: One degree of freedom: one motor drives it completely.
explain.redundantMobile_one: F = {{f}} by Gruebler, but this mechanism moves with {{rank}} DOF because a constraint is redundant (parallel links).
explain.redundantMobile_other: F = {{f}} by Gruebler, but this mechanism moves with {{rank}} DOF because {{count}} constraints are redundant (parallel links).
explain.structure: F = {{f}}: this is a structure; it cannot move.
explain.multiDof: F = {{f}}: it needs {{rank}} inputs; add {{rank}} motors to drive it.
explain.multiDofDriven: F = {{f}}: {{motorCount}} motors drive its {{rank}} DOF together.
explain.singular: At the reference pose the mechanism has {{rank}} instantaneous DOF (singular position).
explain.empty: Draw links and joints to see the mobility.
explain.invalid: The document could not be analyzed.

motors.none: No motor: drag a link to move it; add a motor to use the scrubber.
motors.many_one: {{count}} motors for {{rank}} DOF: the extra motors are ignored.
motors.many_other: {{count}} motors for {{rank}} DOF: the extra motors are ignored.
